Package org.apache.tvm.rpc

Class ConnectTrackerServerProcessor

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.tvm.rpc.ConnectTrackerServerProcessor
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Runnable, ServerProcessor
    public class ConnectTrackerServerProcessor
extends Object
implements ServerProcessor
    Server processor with tracker connection (based on standalone). This RPC Server registers itself with an RPC Tracker for a specific queue (using its device key) and listens for incoming requests.
